sn22.101:1.2: Jānato ham bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi || no ajānato apassato || || 4
sn22.101:1.3: Kiñ ca bhikkhave jānato kim passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || ||
sn22.101:1.4: Iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo || ||
sn22.101:1.8: Iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamoti || ||
sn22.101:1.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 5
sn22.101:2.1: Bhāvanānuyogam ananuyuttassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evam icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:2.2: Aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti || atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati || || 6
sn22.101:2.6: abhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānam abhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānam abhāvitattā pañcannam indriyānam abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānam abhāvitattā sattannam bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa || || 7
sn22.101:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni na sammā paribhāvitāni || 8
sn22.101:3.3: Kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evam icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:3.4: Aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosampadāletvā sotthinā abhinibbijjeyyunti ||
sn22.101:3.5: atha kho abhabbā va te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosam padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ || || 9
sn22.101:3.7: tathā hi pana bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.8: tāni kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni na sammā paribhāvitāni || || 10
sn22.101:3.9: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogam ananuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evam icchā uppajjeyya ||
sn22.101:3.10: Aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti || atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati || 11
sn22.101:3.14: abhāvitattā || catunnam satipaṭṭhānānaṃ || la || atthaṅgikassa maggassa || 12
sn22.101:4.1: Bhāvānuyogam anuyuttassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evam icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:4.2: Aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā ti || atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati || || 13
sn22.101:4.6: bhāvitattā catunnam satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ bhāvitattā catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā pañcannam indriyānam bhāvitattā pañcannam balānam bhāvitattā sattannam bojjhaṅgānam bhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa || || 14
sn22.101:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā ||
sn22.101:5.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni ||
sn22.101:5.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evam icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:5.4: Aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosam padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti ||
sn22.101:5.5: atha kho bhabbā va te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya va mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosam padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ || || 15
sn22.101:5.7: tathā hi pana bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:5.8: tāni kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni || || 16
sn22.101:5.9: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogam anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evam icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:5.10: Ahovata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti || atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati || || 17
sn22.101:5.14: bhāvitattā catunnam satipaṭṭhānānam || la || bhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa || || 18
sn22.101:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave phalagaṇḍassa vā phalagaṇḍante vāsissa vā vāsijaṭe dissante aṅgulipadāni dissanti aṅguṭṭhapādā ||
sn22.101:6.2: no ca khvassa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti
sn22.101:6.3: Ettakaṃ vata me ajja vāsijaṭassa khīṇam ettakam hiyyo ettakam pareti ||
sn22.101:6.4: atha khvassa khīṇam khīṇante va ñāṇaṃ hoti || || 19
sn22.101:6.5: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogam anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti ||
sn22.101:6.6: Ettakaṃ vata me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇam ettakam hiyyo ettakam pareti || athakhvassa khīṇe khīṇante va ñāṇaṃ hoti || || 20
sn22.101:6.7: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave samuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya chammāsāni udake pariyādāya hemantike thalam ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni bandhanāni || tāni pāvussakena meghena abhippavaṭṭāni appakasireneva paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti || || 21
sn22.101:6.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogam anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato appakasireneva saññojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavantīti || || 1-2
